parsed.why: Broad 2023 order forces birth-sex facilities in all state-owned buildings; K-12 bathroom ban, adult care ban in public facilities, no gender-identity protections. National border/document friction remains. Worse than low-risk states but less criminal-enforced than D2.

Statewide criminal-trespass restroom law covers state/local buildings including airports; documented capitol arrest and LGBTQ travel advisory. Identity-document and care restrictions plus no state GI protections make it the harshest traveler exposure.
Low-risk state with gender-identity discrimination protections, X markers, city sanctuary for trans care, no facility ban. National entry/document and custody risks keep it below Reduced Risk.
Low-risk group and no facility ban, but weak recourse: no GI hate-crime or panic-defense reform, youth-targeting laws, Pride cancellation. National border and custody risks persist.

Worst legal-risk group; gender identity stripped from civil rights and localities barred from restoring it. School-grounds birth-certificate bathroom rule reaches visitors; under-18 care ban. No adult public-facility ban, slightly above D1.
